test_title: PYST 5: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: If 9 March 2007 was Friday, then what was the day of the week on 13 March 2012?
solution: Given: **9 March 2007** was Friday. Now, 2007 to 2012 = 5 Years (3 Ordinary Years and 2 Leap Year 2008, 2012). So, 2 Leap Year has 4 odd days, And, 3 Ordinary Years have 3 odd days. Total odd days = 4 + 3 = 7 odd days.
